title: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation
native_title: 無職転生 ～異世界行ったら本気だす～
source: Mushoku Tensei light novels by Rifujin na Magonote (finished), to the end of the main story.
world: A jobless man dies in Japan and is reborn as Rudeus Greyrat in a world of magic, keeping his memories and vowing to live seriously this time. A teleportation disaster scatters his family across the world, and his journey takes him across the Demon Continent and to a magic university as he grows up, marries and becomes a father. He is caught between the mysterious Hitogami (Man-God) and the Dragon God Orsted. A long coming-of-age fantasy about family and regret.
power_system: Magic is cast through incantations or, rarely, silently; ranks go from Beginner to Emperor and God. Sword styles (Sword God, Water God, North God) shape fighters. Demon eyes and curses exist. Rudeus is a prodigy at silent magic and later builds Magic Armor.

timeline.summary: Rudeus learns magic from Roxy and befriends Sylphie.
After the Displacement, Rudeus, Eris and Ruijerd journey home.
Rudeus marries Sylphie; Paul dies in the Begaritt labyrinth; he later marries Roxy and Eris.
Rudeus works with Orsted against Hitogami's apostles.
Rudeus lives as a family man and Orsted's subordinate; his story ends in old age.
